lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots organized into vertical columns, with relatively uniform spacing between local maxima in the central lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs to form a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a pronounced luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Several small, elongated, low-intensity features consistent with commensal fish are visible near the pectoral fin and along the ventral margin.
